topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: To mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band, precise beam management is crucial. High gain beams reduce path loss but limit angular spread, increasing interference. Analog beamforming is cost-effective but introduces phase noise, affecting demodulation efficiency. Hybrid beamforming reduces phase noise but requires more RF chains. Machine learning-based beamforming can adapt to changing channel conditions and user mobility, improving efficiency and reducing 3 dB gain variance. Optimizing both transmit and receive beamforming separately may impact overall efficiency, requiring more RF chains for fully digital solutions. Reconsidering system parameters, such as beamforming and scheduling granularity, is essential due to altered selectivity properties of beamformed equivalent channels in mmWave bands. The joint optimization of transmit and receive beamforming is not addressed in the provided context, which may impact overall efficiency.
